info.title: percall — Arc agent RPC (pay per call)
info.description: Keyless JSON-RPC gateway for AI agents on Arc (chainId 5042, Circle stablecoin chain). Pay per call in USDC via x402 (HTTP 402 + EIP-3009 USDC transferWithAuthorization). No API key. Free tier: 50 calls/day per wallet via X-From header. Full docs: https://percall.io/llms.txt
info.x-guidance: percall: keyless Arc mainnet (chainId 5042) JSON-RPC + early-chain data for AI agents. Send the request unauthenticated first; the server answers HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment requirements. Sign a USDC transferWithAuthorization (EIP-3009) for the quoted amount to the payTo address in the 402 body, retry with the X-PAYMENT header, receive 200 + data + receipt. Payer pays no gas. Free tier: 50 calls/day per wallet via X-From header. Full agent docs: https://percall.io/llms.txt. /meme = trending memecoins + live model scores (S/T/rug). /score = single-token model score (S/T/rug + verdict). /price = token USD quote (all chains, GeckoTerminal).

get.description: GET ?window=<seconds 60-86400, default 3600>. Arc ~2800 deployments/day, scarce early-chain data.
GET ?address=0x..&window=<seconds, default 86400>. Balance + window in/out + top 5 counterparties (contract-checked) + risk flags. Replaces ~8 RPC round-trips.

GET ?chain=<solana|base|bsc|arc|all>&limit=<1-200, default 50>. Latest GMGN trending batch per chain (price, 1h/24h change, volume, liquidity, market cap) joined with live model scores (S signal / T timing / rug probability) where available. Freshness: data_age_s + stale flag in response.
GET ?address=0x<token>. Everything in /audit plus top-10 recipient holders and flow concentration.
GET ?address=0x<token>&chain=<solana|base|bsc|arc>. Model score S (signal) / T (timing) / rug (probability) + verdict (strong/watch/neutral/risky). Universe = trending memecoins, refreshed ~10 min.

GET ?address=0x<token>&chain=<base|bsc|solana|arc>. Token USD price from top pool via GeckoTerminal: price_usd, h1/h6/h24 change, 24h volume, pool liquidity. chain auto-detected from the trending universe when omitted.
